business.title: What kind of business is this?
business.description: e.g. 'a café in Portland', 'a six-person design studio'.

tools.name: contracts_status
tools.description: What needs deciding on the contract desk: notice dates and automatic renewals within 90 days, missed ones first, each with vendor, owner, dates and yearly cost, plus yearly spend by kind. Call it first when asked what's coming up or what the business spends.

tools.name: add_contract
tools.description: Save a contract: title, vendor, kind, yearly or monthly cost in dollars, when the current term ends (YYYY-MM-DD), whether it renews on its own, notice days and owner. An existing id or title is updated, never duplicated. For a price change pass percentChange or monthlyChange and let the desk do the math. Call it as soon as a contract or a price change is mentioned, before you describe it.

tools.name: renew_contract
tools.description: Record that a contract was renewed. Leave endAt out to extend it one more term from its current end date; pass annualCost or monthlyCost when the price changed. Call it the moment the person says it's renewed.

tools.name: cancel_contract
tools.description: Record that notice went out to end a contract, with how it was sent and any reference exactly as written. It stays on the desk until its end date. Call it the moment the person says notice was given.

tools.name: set_contract_status
tools.description: Mark a contract under review (renegotiating or comparing quotes), active again, or ended.

tools.name: add_vendor
tools.description: Save a vendor with its kind and contact, including one with no contract (the electrician you call when something breaks). An existing name is updated, never duplicated.

tools.name: attach_contract_file
tools.description: Link a contract file the person added under contract-files/ to its contract.

tools.name: list_contracts
tools.description: Every contract and vendor with status, dates, yearly cost, contact and contract file.
